protocol.purpose: External inference only; no CPC training, calibration, checkpoint selection or parameter changes
protocol.coordinate_conversion: Published bboxes are xyxy pixel edges; retain exact endpoints; reject invalid source rather than clip or shift
protocol.label_conversion: Arithmetic mean across published per-rater assigned scores, with every raw rater vector retained; not GAIC MOS, no 1..5 normalization
protocol.candidate_policy: Every native annotated candidate; original file order defines crop_id and score tie order

overlap.exact: file SHA256 or decoded RGB SHA256, including mirrored RGB
overlap.perceptual: 32x32 luminance DCT pHash, low8x8 median excluding DC; original and horizontal mirror
overlap.ambiguous_policy: Exclude entire CPC source group if any GAIC TRAIN/VAL pHash proposal within aspect tolerance remains ambiguous; retain every reason and coverage count
overlap.published_AVA_id_collision: Also exclude an entire group if its published ava_obj_* numeric identity equals a GAIC TRAIN/VAL source_id; conservative possible-identity exclusion, not a verified pixel match
overlap.GAIC_TEST: Flag and stratify overlap; do not claim shared sources are an independent test sample

protocol.CPC_source_groups: Union exact/mirrored RGB identities and same published source family after removing _obj_<number>_; unknown original URL coverage remains a limitation
protocol.statistical_unit: source group, average images and then aligned seeds within group; no crop/pair bootstrap
protocol.evaluation_gate: All12 controlled endpoints frozen and main supervisor successfully completed, with no other GPU worker
protocol.manual_geometry_examples: First4 eligible originals by SHA256(source_id), candidate indices0,5,15,23 when present; no model-score selection

report.native_label_scope: Assigned preference scores from CPC, not GAIC 1..5 MOS; dataset-native metrics remain separate
report.limitations: Exact/mirrored/low-distance pHash and conservative AVA-id screen; not a proof that no visually transformed original-content overlap exists. Ambiguous TRAIN/VAL matches excluded without looking at model scores.
